title: Seek Intimacy, Not Power
reading:
"If we seek God for power, we forfeit intimacy."

There's a subtle temptation in the Christian life: to pursue what God can do instead of who He is. We seek answers, breakthroughs, provision, influence — but sometimes overlook the deeper invitation: relationship.

God desires sons and daughters, not just servants. He wants hearts that are in love with Him, not just hands that are working for Him.

When intimacy becomes your focus, everything else finds its proper place. Fruit begins to grow naturally — not through striving, but through abiding. You'll begin to reflect Him without even trying.

There's a grace that comes from being in sync with the Father. In that place, your life becomes an overflow instead of an effort.

Prayer is not just a place to ask — it's a place to receive life. And that life produces everything you need.
reflection: Are there areas where you've been seeking God more for outcomes than for relationship?
abide: Father, I want to know You more than I want anything from You. Align my heart with Yours. Let my life flow from intimacy with You.
